summary: Frontend critical-flow pass completed against the env-configured public URL. Login, dashboard content, navigation, attendance, grades, journal, reports, settings, and responsive menu interactions worked on desktop.
action_items: Re-run the mobile no-overflow assertion after preserving a logged-in state; the first mobile assertion failed without a diagnostic message, while the follow-up reload returned to login and could not reproduce it.
critical_code_review_comments: The UI is intentionally local-state only; save/export/report actions display success toasts but do not persist or download data. This matches the stated MOCK-FREE API integration note only in that no API exists, but should be clarified if real persistence is expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Used https://educator-dashboard-4.preview.emergentagent.com from frontend/.env. Desktop critical flows passed. The originally supplied absenspg preview showed Preview Unavailable, so do not use that stale URL.
rca of the issue: The first browser attempt targeted the stale review URL and received the platform Preview Unavailable page. Against the configured URL, all desktop flows passed. The mobile assertion produced an empty assertion message after navigating from settings; a subsequent reload reset localStorage/login state before measurement, so mobile overflow remains unconfirmed rather than a confirmed product defect.
